coding.title: Coding delivery
coding.boundary: Evidence is bound to a fixed commit. A release candidate is not permission to merge, tag or deploy.
coding.error: Operation failed. Verify permissions, commit identity and provider status.
coding.cleanWorkspace: The task must reference an active local workspace with a clean worktree and matching head.
coding.candidate: Evidence snapshot meets candidate requirements; refresh before acting.
coding.publish: Publish fixed commit to work branch
coding.confirmScope: Confirm this exact commit and action. No production release is performed.
coding.evidenceJson: Checks JSON: commitSha, command, exitCode, startedAt, finishedAt, logRef, status
coding.ci_not_verified_for_head: CI is not verified for this commit

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.privacy: Company administrators manage channels. Secrets stay in the existing vault; saving never sends a message.
notifications.loadError: Unable to load notifications. Check company permissions.
notifications.operationError: Operation failed. Check configuration and permissions, then retry.
notifications.workerOff: Delivery worker disabled by deployment configuration
notifications.notLive: Protocol implementation is not proof of delivery to your real tenant. Accepted does not mean read.
notifications.name: Channel name
notifications.saveHelp: New channels are paused. Enable explicitly and subscribe only to connected events.
notifications.testText: This is an explicitly requested test notification.
notifications.testWarning: This sends a real external message. Check the channel target and content. Retry an uncertain delivery only after reconciliation.

workbuddy.boundary: Official cloud-task integration; personal OAuth is separate from employee login.
workbuddy.error: Operation failed. Review connection and persistent task status before retrying.
workbuddy.warning: This sends your prompt to WorkBuddy and may consume credits. Code/workspace round-trip and confirmed cancellation are not verified.
workbuddy.roundBoundary: A prompt round ending does not prove the business task is complete. Unknown creation is never automatically repeated.

workflow.noCapabilities: No capability summary has been added.

workflowHelp.watchdogExplanation: This task is a generated watchdog task. It verifies whether stopped work in the watched task tree is legitimate.
workflowHelp.parkedBlockerExplanation: Blocked by parked work — at least one assigned blocker is in backlog and will not wake its assignee.
workflowHelp.reviewBoundary: Low-trust review agent. It can only act inside its assigned review boundary; task, project, or run policy defines the concrete scope.
workflowHelp.subtaskWorkspaceChange: This sub-task will no longer use the parent task workspace
workflowHelp.repairReportingChain: Assign this agent to an active manager/root, or explicitly pause or terminate the affected agent/subtree.
workflowHelp.createAgentsHelp: Lets this agent create or hire agents. This also grants task assignment authority.
workflowHelp.createSkillsHelp: Lets this agent install, import, create, and scan organization skills without creating agents.
workflowHelp.localInstructionOnly: Instructions bundles are only available for local adapters.
workflowHelp.instructionNextRun: Saved instructions affect the next run. Active runs keep the instructions they started with, and instruction changes may start a fresh adapter session.
workflowHelp.instructionModes: Managed: Paperclip stores and serves the instructions bundle. External: you provide a path on disk where the instructions live.
workflowHelp.rootPathHelp: The absolute directory on disk where the instructions bundle lives. In managed mode this is set by Paperclip automatically.
workflowHelp.entryFileHelp: The main file the agent reads first when loading instructions. Defaults to AGENTS.md.
workflowHelp.legacyPrompt: Legacy inline prompt — this deprecated virtual file preserves the old promptTemplate content
workflowHelp.olderEdits: Older instruction-only sessions have edits to review.
workflowHelp.entryChanged: The instruction entry changed. These edits remain preserved for the original file.
workflowHelp.reviewingPreserved: Reviewing preserved edits. Save to apply your resolved draft and close this preserved edit.
workflowHelp.instructionsChanged: The current instructions changed after this draft was loaded. Refresh the current revision, compare the instructions, and save your resolved draft again.
workflowHelp.revisionRebuild: Revision saved. The instruction file still needs to be rebuilt from the saved revision.
workflowHelp.filePreserved: This file is preserved with the agent directory. Download it to view its contents.
workflowHelp.keyCreated: API key created — copy it now, it will not be shown again.
workflowHelp.keyHelp: API keys allow this agent to authenticate calls to the Paperclip server.
workflowHelp.approvalNotified: Requesting agent was notified to review this approval and linked tasks.
workflowHelp.linkedTasksOpen: Linked tasks remain open until the requesting agent follows up and closes them.
workflowHelp.routinesHelp: Recurring work definitions that materialize into auditable execution tasks.
workflowHelp.routineDraft: Define the recurring work first. Default project and agent are optional for draft routines.
workflowHelp.policySecondary: Keep policy controls secondary to the work definition.
workflowHelp.routineTriggerHelp: After creation, Paperclip takes you straight to trigger setup. Draft routines stay paused until you add a default agent.
workflowHelp.accountCharges: Account-level charges that do not map to a single inference request.
workflowHelp.currencyBoundary: Finance headline totals are USD only. Other currencies are listed separately; no exchange-rate conversion is applied.
workflowHelp.usageStale: Showing the last loaded API and subscription usage. Updates will resume automatically.
workflowHelp.accountsCheckFailed: Connected accounts could not be checked. Existing subscription estimates are still shown.
workflowHelp.budgetLoadFailed: Budget data could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.
workflowHelp.dataStale: Showing the last loaded data. Updates will resume automatically.
workflowHelp.budgetUpdateFailed: Could not update the budget. Check any pending runs or unpriced usage shown on this page, then try again.
workflowHelp.selectDateRange: Select a start and end date to load data.
workflowHelp.costLoadFailed: Cost data could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.
workflowHelp.policyUpdateFailed: Could not update the budget policy. Review your settings and try again.
workflowHelp.hardStopHelp: Hard-stop spend limits for agents and projects. Provider subscription quota stays separate and appears under Providers.
workflowHelp.resolveBudgetStop: Resolve hard stops here by raising the budget or explicitly keeping the scope paused.
workflowHelp.noBudgetPolicies: No budget policies yet. Set agent and project budgets from their detail pages, or use the existing organization monthly budget control.
workflowHelp.financialEventsFailed: Financial events could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.
workflowHelp.financeGrouping: Account-level financial events grouped by who charged or credited them.
workflowHelp.sharedRunSurface: Uses the shared chat-style run surface from task activity.
